description: Launch, inspect, or tear down an isolated fleet of ready SDD Composy tasks: one branch and Git worktree per member, a bound LOOP, cmux/tmux/headless presentation, no automatic merge. Use to run several ready tasks in parallel — 'rodar várias tarefas em paralelo', 'lançar o fleet', 'fleet status', 'tear down member X'. Do NOT use for a single task (sdd-execute, sdd-loop) or for merging without the explicit teardown token.
